definitions.baseline_band: central 90% interval (5th to 95th percentile) over all baseline token projections for each stage
definitions.state_return: first release-relative token followed by 8 consecutive projections inside that interval
definitions.state_halfway_to_baseline_center: first release-relative token at or closer than halfway from the release projection to the stage baseline-band center
definitions.text_return: first post-release sentence labelled as the stage's baseline persona; null without judge labels
definitions.gap: text return time minus state return time; null if either is missing
definitions.whole_cell_quantiles: nearest-rank quantiles include all eligible samples; a non-returner is ordered after every return and is rendered as >observation_horizon when selected
definitions.conditional_quantiles: separately named conditional_on_return_* quantiles describe only returned samples
definitions.31.3: fraction of labeled prefill samples with any text return; missing judge labels are excluded and counted
definitions.31.6: projection outside the stage baseline band at release-relative token 20; no persistence or early-return proxy
definitions.eos_within_push: excluded from return-time and post-release summary measurements and counted per cell
